plans.close_all: no — the book is flat (rp null, all four layers empty, nothing settled). Start this week's hunt fresh; do not force a trade just to be in the market.
plans.hostage_policy: Run the Hostage Hunt exactly as designed: 4 fixed-resource layers with a constant Risk Parameter per layer (fixed small position size with a wide, pre-computed invalidation stop). Total notional capped at 2,500 (1.0x on the 2,500 reallocation collateral), safely inside the lowest max leverage on the list (GRASS, 3x). Trade to flow with current market conditions, not predictions: majors are corrective (BTC/ETH below last-week VWAP and daily EMA20) while XMR/GRASS/ENA carry the strongest relative flows — so hunt longs where flow is up, shorts where flow is down. Goal is not one big win but repeated small hostages from volatility rotations; if a layer goes NAV(-), hold it within its Risk Parameter and hunt new hostages elsewhere to release it — cut only when the layer's invalidation zone is actually hit or the flow thesis breaks. Any accumulated buffer above the base capital may be risked once per week on the single highest-conviction Zero Alpha setup (tighter stop, larger size); if that shot fails, return immediately to hostage accumulation with the original fixed layers. Mindset discipline: Control Risk, Limit Resources, Wait & See.
plans.rationale: State is a clean start: 10,000 free equity, reallocation to 2,500 collateral, no RP and no open layers, so this plan defines the first four hunting grounds. The universe splits cleanly into two flows: corrective majors (BTC -2.4% 7d below VWAP 81,905; ETH -3.3% 7d / -13.5% 30d below EMA20 2,452 with RSI 34) versus persistent relative strength (XMR 30d +6.6% above rising EMA20/EMA50; GRASS 7d +22% / 30d +37.6% in a clean uptrend; ENA +9.9% 7d holding above EMA50 0.1966). Per TSM Principle #4, Technical is only the tactic that creates the edge — the strategy is the fixed-resource layering, small hostage collection, and NAV(-) release logic. Notional 2,500 keeps effective leverage at 1x versus the 2,500 collateral, below every watchlist symbol's max leverage (min 3x on GRASS), satisfying Control Risk while leaving three unused layers of headroom to compound slowly. Win small, win often, survive first — the Week-1 The5%ers lesson (ego-driven -8.5% drawdown recovered only by strict process) is the standing reminder to obey the plan 100%.
